parse.title: Tempoross
parse.wikitext:
==Starting a game==
Players can begin the encounter by boarding the ship located at the end of the dock in the [[Ruins of Unkah]]. Tempoross can be fought either alone via the 'Solo-start' option on the [[rope ladder]], or by waiting for others on the boat. The encounter will begin 30 seconds after the first player boards, or when 40 players have boarded the boat. It is possible to miss this if the player is performing an emote.

Players do not have to wait for in-progress encounters to finish, as multiple instances of the encounter may run simultaneously.

Followers and [[pet]]s are allowed to be brought in the Tempoross fight, and the fished harpoonfish can be fed to kittens when hungry.

===Required items===
To participate in Tempoross you require the following items:

* A [[rope]] (can be obtained at [[Tempoross Cove]], not required if using the [[Spirit angler's outfit|Spirit Angler outfit]])
* A [[bucket]] (can be obtained at [[Tempoross Cove]])
* A [[hammer]] (can be obtained at [[Tempoross Cove]])
* A [[harpoon]], including a [[barb-tail harpoon]] (can be obtained at [[Tempoross Cove]], not required if using [[barbarian fishing]])
* A [[small fishing net|small]] or [[big fishing net]] (only needed to acquire rewards, can be obtained from [[Spirit Angler]] beside [[Reward pool]])
